issue: Does the reasonable-belief standard for searching a supervised releasee or parolee under a search condition require probable cause?

sides.position: Reasonable belief for a search condition requires a lesser showing than probable cause.
cases: United States v. Thomas, 429 F.3d 282 (D.C. Cir. 2005)
United States v. Vasquez-Algarin, 821 F.3d 467 (3d Cir. 2016)

sides.position: Reasonable belief for a search condition is equated with probable cause.
cases: United States v. Grandberry, 730 F.3d 968 (9th Cir. 2013)
United States v. Howard, 447 F.3d 1257 (9th Cir. 2006)
United States v. Barry, 140 F.4th 1105 (9th Cir. 2025)

this_court: Equates reasonable belief with probable cause under the Ninth Circuit's existing rule (Grandberry, Howard), and applies it in this case.
quote: There is a considerable circuit split on that question.
cite: United States v. Barry, 140 F.4th 1105 (9th Cir. 2025)
